entities.summary: Jacques Lemercier was a French architect and engineer, one of the influential trio that included Louis Le Vau and François Mansart who formed the classicizing French Baroque manner, drawing from French traditions of the previous century and current Roman practice the fresh, essentially French synthesis associated with Cardinal Richelieu and King Louis XIII. Jacques Lemercier was a architects & engineers from Pontoise (1585, Pontoise–1654-01-13). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
